MPC: Multi-Party Computation — a cryptographic scheme that splits private-key control across multiple parties so no single party can spend customer funds alone.
Travel Rule: FATF Recommendation 16 / EU Transfer of Funds Regulation requirement that VASPs/CASPs exchange originator and beneficiary information for transfers above a threshold.
VASP: Virtual Asset Service Provider — FATF terminology for any business performing crypto custody, exchange, transfer, or issuance services.
CASP: Crypto-Asset Service Provider — the EU MiCA term for a regulated VASP operating in the EEA.
MiCA: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation — the EU framework regulating crypto-asset issuance and service provision.
Cold storage: Keys held offline (paper, hardware, air-gapped device) with no network access. Slow to access but not exposed to remote attack.
Hot wallet: Operational wallet with online connectivity, used to settle customer trades. Higher attack surface.
Mixer / tumbler: Service that pools and obfuscates the origin of crypto transactions. High AML/sanctions risk.
Peeling chain: Money-laundering technique that splits a large balance through many small outgoing transactions to obscure provenance.
Rug pull: Token issuer abandons or maliciously drains liquidity, collapsing the token. Common scam pattern.
